# money-paths.txt: money, auth and gating code. An officer PR may change only the TESTS of a
# file whose path matches a pattern here (`*.test.*` / `*.spec.*`); any other change, addition,
# deletion or rename away from a matching path fails .github/workflows/officer-pr-check.yml.
#
# Read from the PR's BASE commit only (fail closed if missing or empty), like
# forbidden-paths.txt, so a PR cannot shrink the list it is judged by. This file is itself
# forbidden to officer PRs (.github).
#
# The set: the ci-watch officer charter's `*buzz*`, `*stripe*`, `*paddle*`, `*payment*`
# services, and the hosted review gate's sensitive-path topics (auth, money, PII, NSFW and
# moderation gating). Broad on purpose: a false positive costs an officer an escalation to a
# human, a false negative lets an unreviewed money or auth change through.
#
# Grammar: forbidden-paths.txt's, but matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY (`*buzz*` matches
# src/components/BuzzButton.tsx). A pattern without '/' is tried against every segment, so a
# directory name matches too (src/server/services/buzz/x.ts).
*auth*
*session*
*permission*
*buzz*
*payment*
*stripe*
*paddle*
*billing*
*purchase*
*payout*
*withdraw*
*subscription*
*email*
*pii*
*nsfw*
*browsing-level*
*browsinglevel*
*moderat*
